_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/CrucibleFurnace/tools/make_shape.py. Native frame, block units, controller cell at [0,0,0]: the front west cell at ground level. One hole across the front row with two pots side by side, pot 1 west and pot 2 east, worked from the front; furnaces stand side by side in a row along x (up to furnace.rowMax), sharing one chimney on one member's outlet, the others capped. No power and no forced air: natural draught, in at the ash mouth (ash, ashSide) under the damper. depth is the lid: 0 open, resting just past upright on its stop (the rest pose), 1 shut, turned about the hinge (hinge). theta is the melter's clock, carried by a ratio-0 rotate on the lid: nothing turns. requires: pot1, pot2, charge1, charge2, melt1, melt2, the coke's three layers coke1..3 (from the grate up) and the same burning, fire1..3; the damper's place, damperopen, damperhalf or dampershut (one at a time); and outletcap. The two cells over the hole are hollow: the lid stands there open (gameplay's collision for it). potNCell: the cell over pot N, worked from its top; outletCell: the stack, the chimney stood on its top; chimney: the shortest chimney, counted from the outlet up. See CrucibleFurnace/README.md.

furnace._comment: pots: the pots in the hole, pot1 and pot2; potUnits: what each pot's drawn melt holds (PotCapacityUnits); cokeLayers, cokePerLayer: the hole's coke is drawn as its layers coke1.. up to ceil(coke / cokePerLayer) (fire.. while lit); minChimney: chimney blocks stood on the outlet, counted from it up (MinChimneyHeight); rowMax, rowAxis: furnaces in a row, side by side along x, sharing one chimney; lidOpenDegrees: how far the lid opens (the hinge's step).
